globals.name: Automation
globals.description: Defines the entrypoint for one automation activation. The name must match the saved definition name when the automation is started.

fields.name: targets
fields.description: Default target set. Omit or use None() when targets are resolved inside the callback.

params.name: fn
params.description: Callback executed when the activation fires.

globals.name: Script
globals.description: Defines a script: fn runs once when an instance starts and may keep working with ctx.after. An instance is the script plus a scope (a saved query, its ctx.targets). Each declared scope gets a switch entity sb-script.script-<name>.<scope> (no scopes: sb-script.script-<name>.run) that is on while that instance runs; switch_turn_on starts it, switch_turn_off stops it gracefully. Automations get sb-script.automation-<name>.enabled; turning it off keeps the automation stopped across restarts.

fields.name: scopes
fields.description: Saved query names offered as switches, one entity each.

fields.name: stop
fields.description: Runs when the switch is turned off, with the instance's targets; may use ctx.after (up to 60 s). Not run by ctx.scripts:stop, stopAll or the stop API, which stop at once.

params.name: fn
params.description: Runs once when the instance starts.

globals.name: Entity
globals.description: Creates an entity trigger or target spec that matches one exact entity key.

params.name: key
params.description: Full entity key such as plugin.device.entity.

globals.name: Query
globals.description: Creates an inline query-backed trigger or target spec. Queries are re-resolved at fire time.

params.name: query
params.description: Storage search key pattern or structured query object.

globals.name: QueryRef
globals.description: Creates a query-backed trigger or target spec from a named storage query resource.

globals.name: None
globals.description: Creates an empty target spec for automations that resolve targets inside the callback.

globals.name: Interval
globals.description: Creates an interval trigger. The runtime clamps intervals below 50ms to 50ms.

params.name: min
params.description: Minimum interval in seconds when using a range.

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum interval in seconds when using a range.

context_methods.name: targets:each
context_methods.description: Iterates the current target entities for the activation firing.

context_methods.name: ctx.decision
context_methods.description: Appends a structured decision/branch event to the automation log stream for the current trace.

params.name: label
params.description: Short branch/decision label such as any_on_true or ignored_falling_edge.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional JSON-serializable fields explaining the decision.

context_methods.name: ctx.send
context_methods.description: Publishes a command subject for the given entity.

context_methods.name: ctx.query
context_methods.description: Resolves entities from storage inside the callback.

params.name: query
params.description: Storage search key pattern or structured query object.

context_methods.name: ctx.queryOne
context_methods.description: Returns the first entity matching the query or nil.

params.name: query
params.description: Storage search key pattern or structured query object.

context_methods.name: ctx.after
context_methods.description: Schedules a one-shot timer owned by the activation.

context_methods.name: ctx.every
context_methods.description: Schedules a repeating timer owned by the activation.

context_methods.name: ctx.cancel
context_methods.description: Cancels a timer created by ctx.after or ctx.every.

params.name: timer_id
params.description: Timer identifier previously returned by ctx.after or ctx.every.

context_methods.name: ctx.scripts:start
context_methods.description: Starts another stored script definition through the normal runtime contract.

params.name: queryRef
params.description: Optional query ref string or table containing queryRef.

context_methods.name: ctx.scripts:stop
context_methods.description: Stops a running script instance through the normal runtime contract.

params.name: queryRef
params.description: Optional query ref string or table containing queryRef.

context_methods.name: ctx.scripts:stopAll
context_methods.description: Stops all running script instances whose targets overlap with the given query ref.

params.name: queryRef
params.description: Query ref string or table containing queryRef.
